title: Extract a fitted collar with a prepared two-jaw screw puller
instruction: Remove the yellow collar from the shaft by turning the prepared puller's screw, and recover the collar in the green tray. Leave the intact puller level on its rest posts, facing as it started, then open both grippers and move them at least 8 cm clear; the collar and the tool must stay still for two seconds.
context: Maintenance disassembly using a loose screw puller: one gripper counterholds the tool while the other turns its screw, then the removed collar is recovered and the tool parked. Both hooks are pre-engaged by the operator; fitting the puller is not part of this task.
setup: Standard YAM station, table height 74.75 cm; x forward, y left. Original machined training components: fixed flange 10 x 10 x 1 cm with 12.000 +/-0.001 mm ground steel shaft (shoulder 3.5 cm, centre-cup rim 3.8 cm above table), centred x 28, y 4 cm. Yellow integral iglidur J polymer collar: lower 2 mm land free bore 11.990 +/-0.002 mm, 22 mm diameter x 4 mm hub, 44 mm diameter x 10 mm rim; remaining bore relieved to 13 mm, calculated mass 22.21 g, hub bottom 1 cm above table. Loose puller body: 10 x 1.6 x 1.2 cm crossbar, 3 cm boss, black-coated 11 x 2 x 2.4 cm side handle with 2.4 x 3 x 2.4 cm end grip, 120 g; centre over shaft 7.75 cm above table. Die-cast orange knob: 36 mm diameter x 20 mm, 120 g, centre 4.8 cm above body. Metal guided ram: 8 mm tip pad, 5 mm point, 20 g, initially unextended. Two metal jaws: 6 x 14 x 56 mm arms, 16 x 14 x 3 mm hook lips, 20 g each; axes +/-25 mm, hooks pre-engaged under collar rim. Empty green rigid plastic tray: floor 12 x 10 x 0.4 cm, 11 x 9 cm interior, 0.5 cm walls rising 1.4 cm above table, centre x 28, y 18 cm. Two fixed metal rest posts, each 6 x 16 x 89 mm, span the tray at +/-45 mm in x and support the crossbar centre 9.5 cm above table. Nominal materials describe intended construction; contact properties and masses are authored, not calibrated.
scoring: Initially 0. 0.25 after the collar clears the shaft with both jaws retained and at least two measured clockwise screw turns. 0.5 when that collar rests fully inside the tray. 1.0 when the intact tool is upright on its rest (4 mm horizontal and 3 mm vertical centre tolerance, 5 degrees orientation), the collar remains in the tray, both grippers are open and at least 8 cm from all loose part origins and the side-handle grip point, and all loose parts remain within 2 mm and 2 degrees for 2 seconds. Invalid states or a separated tool score 0. See scoring.py for exact geometric checks.
reset_notes: Restore the pre-engaged puller, fitted collar, shaft, empty tray and robot ready poses; reset screw rotation, friction anchors and scoring history. No consumables.
fidelity: Integral iglidur J collar interference uses offline axisymmetric polymer elasticity plus approximate solid/cup steel compliance and axial friction (14.61 N nominal). Force falls with land overlap; release at 28 mm rise clears the cup rim. Rigid collision bore is relieved. Modulus/friction use manufacturer data; Poisson ratio and static=dynamic friction are assumptions. No measured calibration, creep or thread contact. Screw is a compliant 12 mm/turn coupling.
scores: Calculated polymer-fit revision: scripted demo 1.0; reset repeat 1.0 (1,588 steps each). Dream-1 (dreamlabs/dream-1-beta): 0.0, 2,000 steps, seed 0, no errors. Same instruction, scene and scorer.
